DECIDE.

TAROT FOR DECISIONS

Decisions you can truly stand by.

DECIDE. doesn’t predict your future with AI. It helps you organize what’s on your mind, decide for yourself, and look back on the outcome a few days later.

DECIDE. is a decision-support web app. It uses tarot cards not as fortune-telling, but as material for thinking. From small everyday choices — buy or not, go or not — to bigger ones like changing jobs or moving house, it gives you a viewpoint you hadn’t considered, so your own answer can surface.

How it works

  1. Put it into words. Name the one thing you’re torn about.
  2. Draw a card. Read the viewpoint it offers — one card, or two to compare options A and B.
  3. Decide, and record it. The choice is always yours. Keep what you decided, and why.
  4. Look back. A few days later (three by default), DECIDE. quietly asks how it went.

How it’s different

  • You decide. Many AI tarot apps hand you an interpretation as the answer. DECIDE. presents the card as material for thinking — the decision stays with you.
  • It doesn’t end at the reading. Your decision and your reasons are recorded, and you revisit the outcome a few days later.
  • Real choices, not fortunes. Buying, going, reaching out, changing jobs — the everyday decisions that actually fill a life.

Price

Free to start: 5 card draws and 5 decision records. If you continue, UNLIMITED is a one-time purchase of ¥980 (tax included) — no monthly fee, no credits, no extra charges. It removes the limits and enables cloud sync.

Open DECIDE. in English

No download needed — it runs in your browser. You don’t need to believe in fortune-telling to use it.
